originalTitle: Shein's slowing growth tests investor appetite ahead of Hong Kong IPO
simplifiedContent: Shein, a large fashion company, is planning to sell stocks to the public in Hong Kong, but investors are being cautious. This is because Shein's growth has slowed down lately, which is a change from its previous rapid expansion. The company is facing higher costs and changes in the market that are making it harder for it to make money in the same way it used to. Investors are worried that Shein won't be able to grow as quickly as it did before, which is making them question whether they want to invest in the company. This skepticism could affect how well Shein's stock sale goes.

originalTitle: IndiQube Spaces Q1 revenue jumps 37% to record Rs 428 crore
simplifiedContent: IndiQube Spaces, a company, had a great first quarter with its revenue increasing by 37% to ₹428 crore. This means they made more money compared to the same time last year. Their profits also went up, with one type of profit called EBITDA increasing by 34% and another called PAT rising by 91% to ₹35 crore. This is a positive sign for the company, showing that its business is growing and doing well. The company's success is likely due to its ability to manage more space and provide additional services to its customers.

originalTitle: Pilani Investment to sell 1.7 million UltraTech Cement shares for ₹1,908 crore
simplifiedContent: Pilani Investment is going to sell 1.7 million shares of UltraTech Cement, which is worth about ₹1,908 crore. They will sell these shares on August 13, 2026, at a price that is 3% lower than the current price. This means that the buyer will get the shares at a slightly cheaper price than what they are currently worth. UltraTech Cement, the company whose shares are being sold, is also making a separate investment in a company called Solaris Horizon Energy to help with its plans for using green energy. This sale of shares and the investment in Solaris Horizon Energy are two separate events.

originalTitle: From Trent to Titan: Over 15 Tata Group stocks more than doubled investors' wealth during Chandrasekaran's tenure
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: The Tata Group, a big company, has had a very successful time under its leader, N Chandrasekaran. Many of the company's stocks (which are like pieces of the company that people can buy) have more than doubled in value, with some even increasing by over 1,000%. This means that people who invested in these stocks have made a lot of money. Chandrasekaran will be stepping down as leader in February 2027, after a long 40-year career. This matters because it shows how well the company has done under his leadership, and investors will be watching to see what happens next.

originalTitle: Nvidia, Apple, Google fuel record $185 billion gain for Norway’s wealth fund, but CEO say, ‘We are really cautious’
simplifiedContent: Norway's government has a huge investment fund worth $2.3 trillion, and it just reported a record gain of $185 billion in the first half of the year. This means the fund made a lot of money from its investments, recovering from some losses it had earlier in the year. The fund's success is partly due to investments in big tech companies like Nvidia, Apple, and Google. Despite this good news, the fund's CEO is being cautious, which suggests they're not getting too excited about the gains. This matters because the fund's performance can have a big impact on Norway's economy and finances.

originalTitle: Wall Street rises after in-line consumer inflation data, AI and chip stocks jump
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is like a place where people buy and sell pieces of companies, is doing well today. This is because some new information about inflation, which is like a measure of how fast prices are rising, came out and it was what people were expecting. As a result, the main groups of stocks, like the S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq, are all going up a little bit. This means that people who own stocks in these groups are making a small amount of money today. Overall, the market is up, with the Nasdaq doing the best, rising 0.7% so far.
